guides.favoredWhen: She Cleanses sleep and answers your R at the return. Hold bubble, vary Qs, track Cleanse.

keyTips.text: She takes Cleanse to remove sleep, then one-shots: the summoner is her lane, so bait it.
She dodges Q and E: sidesteps beat both, so lead.
Free if your E is wasted: no bubble means no defense, so hold it.

tips.text: She respects Electrocute and ignite burst: your spikes kill, so force them.
She watches item drops: your pickups change the trade, so vary them.
When you R toward her she R1s through and E1s your return: vary the portal.
She tracks bubble cooldown: wasted-E windows are her kill windows, so hide it.
Slept plus returned: the Akali who never dodges never wins.

sources.author: Anguish333
sources.rankClaim: Master (profile badge; title claims 2000LP GrandMaster EUW and Challenger EUNE) · Akali main

guides.favoredWhen: She hugs minions against bubble and punishes portals with Charm. Vary angles, hold Exhaust threat.

keyTips.text: She stays near minions so they block your E sleep bubble: splash or wait.
She answers bubble with W: never throw it raw, pair it.
When you ult in, she ults and Charms your cast spot: you snap back to it, so vary.

tips.text: She concedes pressure in levels 1-5: press before her answers come online.
Your Exhaust and Ignite pickups keep her Charm defensive: show them.
She Charms every portal forward: never portal predictably.
She calls her jungler from 6 on: duels favour you, ganks favour her, so track it.
She wins through ganks and cooldown punishes, not duels: you find the 1v1 easy, so force it.

guides.favoredWhen: Slightly hers. She blocks with creeps and stuns your snap-back. Punish wasted stuns, snowball.

keyTips.text: Skill matchup, slightly hers: steal edges before she banks them.
She keeps creeps between to block Q and sleep bubble: the wave is her shield, so splash.
If you waste bubble she plays very aggressive: the cooldown is her window, so hold it.

tips.text: She respects your summoners and items: vary pickups.
She calls ganks: you are very gankable with weak waveclear, so ward.
Your all-ins end; her pressure does not: pick windows, never force.
After 6, if you ult forward she steps up and stuns your snap-back: vary the return.
Snowballed plus returns kept: the Syndra whose edges never banked loses the skill check.

sources.author: Trisend3
sources.rankClaim: Challenger (title and profile badge) · Syndra main

guides.favoredWhen: He outranges you, takes Cleanse, and times shurikens for your return. Vary portals, hold bubble.

keyTips.text: He outranges you: max-range shadows are his safe damage, so close.
He checks your spellbook every back: vary pickups.
He takes Cleanse: escaping sleep means he all-ins freely, so bait it.

early-lane.text: Zed often places Living Shadow before Death Mark so he can swap away from skillshots. Hold your crowd control until he has used the swap.

win-condition.text: Death Mark always lands Zed behind his target. Pre-aim crowd control and escapes behind you, not toward where he cast it.

tips.text: He respects your passive autos early: press walk-ups.
He takes Cleanse or TP: the summoner is his safety net, so punish the window after use.
Death Mark always lands Zed behind his target. Pre-aim crowd control and escapes behind you, not toward where he cast it.
He times a triple Q on your R return spot: you always come back, so vary portals.
Sleep landed plus return varied: with his Cleanse down and Qs dodged, his answers run out.

keyTips.text: With Electrocute and Ignite, play for solo-kill pressure after Sleepy Trouble Bubble lands, following with Paddle Star and Ignite.
Trade Paddle Star into an empowered passive auto into Paddle Star again for Electrocute; the empowered auto keeps the exchange useful even when Q misses.

Fish for Bubble as an opponent steps forward to last-hit, when their movement turns predictable, and after level six clear the back wave with Paddle Star when damage allows to remove minion cover for Bubble attempts.

tips.text: Extend a forward Bubble angle with Portal Jump only from a safe launch point, since hard engage punishes Zoe hardest.
Conserve mana before Lost Chapter and blue buff, spending nothing on cooldown without a clear trade or wave purpose.
On the Unsealed Spellbook and Teleport plan, trade health for the opponent's, then recall and teleport back to make them lose farm.
Open Doran's Ring and Health Potions, with Dark Seal, boots, and Lost Chapter among the early buys.
Skip extended side-laning: collect side waves as they reach the tower, pushing them only toward the river rather than committing long.
Balance that safe farm with arriving early at dragon or Rift Herald fights, where the long-range pick can decide whether the enemy contests.
When first to an objective, hit a high-value target with Bubble or Paddle Star to create the advantage before both teams fully commit.
Throw Sleepy Trouble Bubble through walls and follow with Paddle Star poke, using terrain for cover so the return engage never finds Zoe.
Prioritize Bubble and poke on enemy carries when the angle exists; otherwise chip the frontline instead of forcing a risky dive.
Fire Portal Jump only from a position whose return point stays safe, keeping hard engage answered by distance.

itemization.text: Run Electrocute with Taste of Blood, Deep Ward, Relentless Hunter, Nimbus Cloak, and Scorch, with Unsealed Spellbook and Teleport as the separate recall-and-return lane plan.

Complete Luden's Echo, Sorcerer's Shoes, Shadowflame, Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, and Horizon Focus, choosing Ionian Boots, Sorcerer's Shoes, or Mercury's Treads by game with Mercury's flagged against double AP and crowd control.
Keep Mejai's Soulstealer for snowballs, Morellonomicon for healing, Zhonya's or Banshee's for defense, and Lich Bane for damage as situational picks.
